theory.text: Choose the option or specified number of options that the passage supports. A distractor may repeat a keyword while changing the meaning, cause, date or comparison.
Key skills: Detailed reading, paraphrase recognition and elimination.

guide.text: Read the question and choices  locate the relevant passage  identify the supported answer in your own words  compare all choices  select the exact number requested.

small.text: Text: “The course first enrolled adults in 2016; a version for teenagers followed two years later.”
Why was 2018 important? A. Adult classes began. B. A teenage version started. C. The course ended.

full.text: An engineering team tested two building materials in a coastal laboratory. Material X was cheaper to produce, but it deteriorated quickly when exposed to saltwater. Material Y cost more initially and retained its strength in the same conditions. Researchers recommended Y for structures expected to remain near the sea for many years.

1. What was the main weakness of Material X?A. High production cost   B. Poor saltwater resistance   C. Excessive weight2. Why was Material Y recommended?A. It retained its strength   B. It required no testing   C. It was cheaper

rows: The teenage version started two years after 2016.
Choosing FALSE when evidence is missing
Use FALSE only if the passage contradicts the statement; otherwise consider NOT GIVEN.

Summarise the paragraph’s full main idea.

Recheck NO MORE THAN ... WORDS instructions and spelling.

Move on and return after easier questions.
